newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Blood thicker than ideology for Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: Blood thicker than ideology for Netanyahu.

text.p: Blood apparently runs thicker than ideology for Israeli leader Benjamin Netanyahu.
Netanyahu scrapped an emergency meeting with Jewish settler leaders after his four-year-old son Yair fell flat on his face and scratched his lip at kindergarten on Thursday.
Netanyahu, a champion of Jewish settlement in the West Bank and Gaza, and wife Sara abandoned their official schedules to rush young Yair off to hospital.
"He's going to be okay," an aide said.
